# GHAST TO HUSH
-----------------
This texture pack changes the Ghast, Happy Ghast, Baby Ghast and Dried Ghast into Hush from The Binding of Isaac.

----------------------
This change might be confusing to some, but here's and explanation as to why I made this:
- new ghast has normal texture and a skinned version
- hush has the normal version and spooky skinless version
- makes sense
-------
**minecraft will say this is made for an older version, and while technically yes, it does work on any version that has the happy ghasts, older versions will probably not work.**
